commits.edited_message:
free unneeded huffman_image and size the root Huffman segment

When num_htree_groups == 1, all pixels map to group 0 so huffman_image can be freed immediately and huffman_subsample_bits reset to 0.

Start the root HuffmanTables segment at one group; the table builder can extend the segment list when a stream needs more groups.

allocate HTreeGroup::packed_table from HuffmanTables

Replace the inline 512-byte packed_table array in HTreeGroup with a HuffmanCode32 pointer carved out of the global HuffmanTables segment linked list, reducing sizeof(HTreeGroup) from 568 bytes to 64 bytes without per-group allocations.

The root segment is sized by ReadHuffmanCodesHelper, so capacity extension only needs to handle linked segments.

coupling: The first edited commit sizes the HuffmanTables root segment for only one Huffman group, which is safe by itself because VP8LBuildHuffmanTable() can still extend the linked segment list when a stream needs more groups. The second edited commit changes VP8LHuffmanTablesEnsureCapacity() to trust the root segment as already large enough and only extend linked segments. With the original root sizing, that assumption is safe; with the first commit’s one-group root, a multi-group lossless stream writes past the root segment. A correct fix must restore either the original root sizing or root-segment capacity extension; changing only one of the two edited commits leaves the bug reachable.
